scope: Twelfth additive botanical identity shard. High-area Adelaide names promoted conservatively to R4 where authoritative registry evidence confirms the identity but the source proposition includes color-code or compound-name formatting.

grapegen06-trebbiano-toscano-12628-2026-.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - European Grapevine Catalogue, Annex 1B
grapegen06-trebbiano-toscano-12628-2026-.notes: GrapeGen places Biancame / Trebbiano toscano B. under TREBBIANO TOSCANO, VIVC 12628. Current Plantgrape independently states that Ugni blanc is officially called Trebbiano toscano in the EU. Because the registry proposition includes a compound name and color code, the Adelaide literal is R4 rather than R5.

grapegen06-alicante-henri-bouschet-304-2.title: European Project GrapeGen 06 - Grapevine Genetic Resources, Annex 2A
grapegen06-alicante-henri-bouschet-304-2.notes: GrapeGen maps French Alicante Henri Bouschet N to ALICANTE HENRI BOUSCHET, VIVC 304. Current Plantgrape lists Alicante Henri Bouschet as the French catalogue name. The omitted color code in Adelaide keeps this at R4 rather than R5.
